brief:
Nicholas Kristof, a Pulitzer Prize-winning New York Times columnist, characterized Israeli demolition of Palestinian structures in the West Bank as ethnic cleansing following a spring visit to villages in the territory, Middle East Eye reported. During his reporting trip, Kristof said Israeli settlers had blocked him from accessing some Palestinian communities.

The columnist's comments reflect mounting international scrutiny of Israeli settlement expansion and the associated demolitions affecting Palestinians in occupied territory. Kristof's characterization adds to a broader debate over Israeli policies in the West Bank, where Palestinian villages have faced repeated demolitions tied to Israeli settlement activity. His visit and subsequent remarks have drawn attention to access restrictions facing journalists and observers documenting conditions in Palestinian areas.
